limits.value: about 1 request a second on the index, per the platform research report
a crawl index call is bounded at 5 s the listing ends at 8 s

reliability_note: 504 to a direct index call; 9 consecutive probe timeouts as of 02:50Z 2026-10-22

evidence.proved: 504 Gateway Time-out after 11.3 s from nginx: the index did not answer
state failing, 9 consecutive probe timeouts, the only provider not ok

notes: Degraded, not dead, and the distinction is the finding: the index answered 504 to a direct call and has failed nine broker probes in a row. A listing can return unknown for every crawl it could not read, so an empty answer is not evidence of absence.
